name: pranexusai
description: PranexusAI: preventive health for Bengaluru with published risk scores, live air quality and AI nutrition

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && python -m pip install -r ai-service/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && cd ai-service && python -m pytest -q
